rows.title: Design → Spacing → Line Height: − / + from a two-decimal value (Spacious 1.65, 1-Page Fit 1.35 / 1.25) jumped 0.15 and skipped a step, and a typed 1.35 / 1.65 was stored as 1.4 / 1.6
rows.summary: Now: NumberRow's − / + land on the next step below / above (ceil/floor with an epsilon, as GapStepper does): from 1.65 they give 1.6 / 1.7, from 1.35 1.3 / 1.4, from 1.25 1.2 / 1.3. A typed value on a fractional-step row keeps two decimals (1.35 stays 1.35, 1.65 stays 1.65), rounding off only float error; whole-step rows (margins, gaps) still store whole numbers.

rows.title: Job match and the ATS keyword check counted a certificate's Link label after its Link URL was cleared, although nothing prints it and the editor hides its box
rows.summary: Now: extractResumeCorpus takes a certificate's Link label (or the address) only while its Link URL is set, as every renderer and export prints it; a stale hidden label no longer counts as a matched keyword.

issues: R5-HUNT9-REVIEW-CERT-BLANK-URL-LABEL: f593c60e left a certificate's Link label out of the corpus when its Link URL was blank after trimming (`fieldText(item.url).trim()`), and its test enshrined that for '   '. The editor shows the label box and the PDF (PdfSectionsTwo, PdfSidebarColumn) and Word (wordExportBuilders) print the label whenever the URL is any non-empty text (`item.url && ...`), so a URL of a stray space still printed 'Kubernetes Administrator' while the job match called Kubernetes missing. Fixed in 3bab9e72: the corpus tests the URL as the renderers do; the '   ' case in the original test was a stale expectation from the same branch and became the new test's positive case.
review.notes: 86d0fd31 (Line Height steps) reviewed clean: root cause fixed in NumberRow; the only fractional-step caller is Line Height; whole-step rows (margins, gaps) now also step from a template's fractional value (13.33) to the neighbouring whole number instead of skipping one, as intended; typed values keep two decimals and are still clamped to LINE_HEIGHT 1-3; no caller, sync, undo or export path depends on snapped values. Both original failfirst checks were green in 36646946365 (each test failed without, passed with). Run 36648641588: failfirst for 3bab9e72 (fail 1 without, pass with), 234/234 area tests (ats-*, r5-hunt*-ats-*, r5-hunt9-*, import-markdown-links, json-resume-sections, markdown-export-sections, pdf 10/13/70, line-height half-step) and lint green. Noted (pre-existing, outside this cluster): Markdown export and the ATS plain text print no label for a whitespace-only URL, unlike the PDF and Word.

notes: Base moved from ca009d49 to 185192d7 (origin/claude/r4-green at start). No earlier partial branch existed. One dispatch ran both fail-first checks plus the touched area's tests (line-height 106/108, ats-*, r5-hunt1-ats-*, knowledge-docs, 91-design-resets).
